gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could open states a dated, maker-store price for each board in this field: on 2026-11-21 Keychron lists the K3 Max from $72.49 (ChatGPT's card said $87.49) and shows the K3 Pro sold out, Lofree's checkout takes the Flow Lite84 to $79.20 (ChatGPT's card said $99.99), and Akko's US store has the Air 01 at $89.99-$99.99 with a pre-order notice (ChatGPT's card said $74.99).
standout_why: Compared against pcreviewer.org (cited), kbdcompare.com (cited), gaminglaptopguru.com and pcpartsgeek.com. pcreviewer gives only price tiers, no dollar figures. gaminglaptopguru and pcpartsgeek are the two 'under $100' pages and neither states a single price; both send readers to Amazon. kbdcompare has dated prices for only three boards (K3 Pro $67.99/$74.99/$83.99, Air75 V3 $139.95, MX Mechanical Mini $159.99) and no stock status. None mentions the K3 Pro being sold out at Keychron, Lofree's in-cart 20% off, or the Akko pre-order notice. Not compared: purchase.fyi (cited, certificate error) and technobezz.com (cited, HTTP 403) could not be opened, and rtings.com, mkbguide.com and the other uncited results were not opened, so the 'no result' claim covers four of the pages only.
decides: It confirms the two top picks fit the budget and shows both cost less at the maker than ChatGPT's cards: Keychron K3 Max from $72.49 and Lofree Flow Lite84 at $79.20 at checkout. It weakens the second chat's K3 Pro pick, which is sold out at Keychron on the date read, and the Akko Air 01 pick, which is $89.99-$99.99 with a pre-order notice at Akko rather than $74.99. It also widens the field under the $100 line: Lofree Flow Lite 2 84 ($87.20 through our link, already a record) and the aluminum Lofree Flow84 ($95.20 through our link, already a record) both qualify, as do Keychron's K3 Max SE ($78.74), K3 HE ($95.99) and K3 Ultra 8K ($98.99). The line leaves out Lofree Flow 2 84 at $127.20 and, by kbdcompare's figure, NuPhy Air75 V3 at $139.95. The page has honest linkable rows, so no skip. Not settled: the NuPhy Node75 price (store rate-limited) and the K3 Max hot-swappable variant's price.
